newsitem.title: USA: Grubb & Ellis names Brian Parker as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Grubb & Ellis names Brian Parker as CFO.

text.p: Grubb & Ellis Co said on Monday it named Brian Parker as chief financial officer and senior vice president, filling a vacancy that was created by the departure five months ago of Robert Hanlon.

The commercial real estate company also said it named Steven Scruggs as president, corporate and institutional services; Michael McKiernan president, commercial brokerage operations eastern United States and Donald Morrow, president, commercial brokerage operations, western United States.
Except for the CFO spot, the other positions are newly created.
Before joining Grubb & Ellis, Parker was chief financial officer and senior vice president at Balcor Co in Bannockburn, Ill.
